movers.headline: receives confirmation of a new HVAC Assembly business award from Maruti Suzuki, approx. Rs 1,225 cr over the ~7-year model life cycle
Board approves raising funds up to Rs 49 cr via a Rights Issue to existing shareholders, price and ratio not yet fixed, subject to SEBI ICDR and other approvals (board-approval stage)
secures new orders aggregating approx. Rs 1,199 cr across Transmission and Renewable Energy segments
secures a Rs 11.28 cr work order from Powerica Limited for positioning, testing and commissioning of a Princeton Digital Group data centre, 4-month execution
Board approves raising up to Rs 1,800 cr via QIP, subject to shareholder approval at an EGM convened for 18-Nov-2026 (not yet executed)
allots 22,27,544 preferential equity shares at Rs 1,670/share (aggregating Rs 372 cr) to 18 investors including WhiteOak Capital-managed funds and Ashish Kacholia
awarded orders totalling Rs 362.34 cr -- a firm Princeton Digital Group order plus a DXDC Chennai letter of intent, split not disclosed
approves a 2.0 MTPA GGBS grinding-system addition at its Vijayanagar plant for Rs 509 cr, commissioning by May 2028
two same-day orders summed: Rs 131.88 cr Letter of Acceptance from the Directorate of Postal Life Insurance (System Integrator for IMS, 5 years) plus a separate Rs 27.38 cr order
Board approves an open-market buyback of equity shares for an amount not exceeding Rs 90 cr at a price not exceeding Rs 7,500/share

order_wins: **Sanmit Infra Ltd** -- subsidiary Sanmit Truevalue Infraprojects receives a Work Order (Rs 3.16 cr; ~4.5% of mcap).
**Vikram Solar Limited** -- secures a 289.87 MWp order for a grid-scale solar project in Rajasthan from NLC India Limited.

**VA Tech Wabag** -- secures a 'Mega' order (by WABAG's own domestic classification, above Rs 1,000 cr; ~9.4% of mcap on that floor) from Reliance Industries to deliver a desalination and remineralisation plant at Jamnagar, exact value not stated (filed twice; carried once).
**Urban Enviro Waste Management** -- remediation of 5.69 Ton legacy waste on the Waryana dump site for Municipal Corporation Jalandhar, value not disclosed (filed twice; carried once).
**Waaree Renewable Technologies Limited** -- bagging/receiving of orders/contracts, value not disclosed.
**KNR Constructions Limited** -- revocation of a Letter of Award (not an order win).
**Kothari Industrial Corporation Ltd** -- award, value not disclosed.

**Sai Urja Indo Ventures** -- declared L1 (lowest bidder) by NTPC for a Rs 20.64 cr (~16.2% of mcap) biennial electrical-maintenance contract at NTPC Mouda -- an L1 declaration is not yet an award (corrects the baseline, which read this as a top mover).
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Fratelli Vineyards** -- Letter of Offer for a PROPOSED rights issue of up to 33,18,503 partly-paid shares at Rs 90/share (incl. Rs 80 premium), 10:131 ratio, aggregating up to Rs 29.87 cr; record date 30-Oct-2026, not yet allotted.
**Akshar Spintex Limited** -- integrated financial filing for the quarter ended 30-Sep-2026.
**Cinevista Limited** -- integrated filing (financial) for the quarter ended 30-Sep-2026.
**Indergiri Finance Ltd** -- cancellation of its Rights Issue Committee meeting.
**Esha Media Research Ltd** -- as per letter attached, no further detail.
**Fynx Capital** -- proposed rights issue of equity shares to eligible shareholders, terms not yet fixed.
equity_allotments: **Avalon Technologies Limited** -- outcome of Board Meeting (Rs 425.00 cr).
**Tuni Textile Mills** -- Rights Issue Committee allots 46,91,79,280 fully paid Rights Equity Shares at Rs 1/share, Rs 46.92 cr aggregate; paid-up capital rises from Rs 13.06 cr to Rs 59.98 cr.
⚑ **Sealmatic India Ltd** -- Preferential Issue outcome and disclosure (Rs 15.01 cr) _(⚑ filing content disagrees with the subject tag -- held out of movers)_.
**Beryl Securities Ltd** -- allots 11,78,005 preferential equity shares at Rs 23/share (Rs 2.71 cr) to promoters and public shareholders.
**Osel Devices Limited** -- general updates, no amount disclosed.
m_and_a: **Maral Overseas** -- Board approves a revised Rs 3.64 cr consideration (up from Rs 2.60 lakh) for its already-disclosed acquisition of a 26% stake in Asawata Energy Private Limited for a 15 MW captive solar plant (filed four times; carried once -- the baseline's Rs 180 cr on this line is the same filing's separate, not-yet-committed capex plan, see Capex).
**EFC (I) Limited** -- final date of hearing of the demerger scheme petition between EFC Limited and EFC (I) Limited.

**Shah Investor's Home Limited** -- Board approves the acquisition of 71,857 equity shares (6.25% paid-up capital) of Ficus Food Lab Private Limited, consideration not disclosed (filed under two subject tags; carried once).
**Tilak Ventures Ltd** -- Regulation 30 announcement for approval of a Scheme of Arrangement.
**Syschem India Ltd** -- results for the quarter and half year ended 30-Sep-2026.
**Lloyds Metals And Energy Limited** -- update on acquisitions, detail not cached.
**Aeroflex Enterprises Limited** -- amendment of the Objects Clause of its Memorandum of Association.
**Waaree Energies Limited** -- outcome of Board Meeting, no acquisition detail cached.
**Nephrocare Health Services** -- step-down wholly owned subsidiary Nephrocare Health Services (Philippines) Inc. acquires a stake, detail not cached.
**Nephrocare Health Services** -- a separate Reg 30 intimation on an ATA/JCM dialysis centre, detail not cached.

**Liqvd Digital India** -- acquires the remaining 23.21% of Adlift Marketing Private Limited, taking its stake to 100% (now a wholly owned subsidiary); consideration not disclosed in the cached pages.
**SBI Funds Management Ltd** -- intimation of an application submitted to the Exchange.
capex_core: **SecMark Consultancy** -- proposes to invest up to Rs 48 cr in a wholly owned/to-be-incorporated subsidiary to establish a Mineral Exchange, subject to IBM registration (application due by 2-Nov-2026) -- not yet executed.
**Kilburn Engineering Ltd** -- intimation of a Board meeting.

**Acme Solar Holdings** -- subsidiary Acme Greentech Seventh commissions a further 35.77 MW/143.08 MWh BESS component (of a 300 MW/1,200 MWh FDRE project at Kelan, Rajasthan, under a PPA with SJVN), taking cumulative commissioned BESS capacity to 195.35 MW/781.40 MWh.
**Kalana Ispat Limited** -- commencement of production of Alloy Steel Round Bars at its new Rolling Mill project, Ahmedabad.
business_updates: **Results season** — 158 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.

**Coal India** -- H1 FY27 capex of Rs 7,966 cr, up 27% YoY and 109% of the H1 target, driven by mine infrastructure, land acquisition, HEMM and diversification spend; the Rs 16,500 cr in its headline is the FULL-YEAR capex target, not an acquisition amount (corrects the baseline's 'acquisition' tag).
**Morepen Laboratories Limited** -- Q2 FY27 revenue up 81% YoY to Rs 755 cr, EBITDA up 273% to Rs 132 cr, PAT up 117% to Rs 89 cr, on CDMO scale-up.
**Veefin Solutions Ltd** -- H1 FY27 revenue up 116% YoY to Rs 238.82 cr, EBITDA up 160% to Rs 60.81 cr, PAT up 127% to Rs 24.85 cr.

**Kreon Finnancial Services (StuCred)** -- Q2 FY27 disbursements up 10.9% QoQ to Rs 121.63 cr, revenue up 61% YoY to Rs 16.89 cr, PAT up 118% YoY to Rs 4.46 cr; AUM Rs 53.27 cr, collection efficiency 96.6%.
**Choice International** -- press release on issuance and allotment of CCPS to NH Investment & Securities by material subsidiary Choice Equity Broking.
**Mahindra Lifespace Developers Limited** -- press release on a 10.05-acre land-parcel development in North Bengaluru.

**Arisinfra Solutions Limited** -- secures a DaaS services order for Transcon Ramdev Plaza, Santacruz (Mumbai), via subsidiary Arisunitern RE Solutions; the project's estimated GDV of Rs 250 cr is the SPV's total project value, not the service-order consideration, which is not disclosed.
**ACC Limited** -- media release on trade mix, capacity expansion and the One Cement Platform initiative.

**Allcargo Global** -- September LCL volume of 689,000 cbm, down 4% YoY and 4% MoM on supply constraints and vessel roll-overs; FCL volume 48,758 TEUs, down 10% YoY on the Middle East conflict; 40-foot container utilisation improved YoY.
**Alembic Pharmaceuticals** -- its ANDA for Valganciclovir for Oral Solution, 50 mg/mL, receives USFDA final approval.

**Sky Gold and Diamonds** -- Q2/H1 FY27 results (consolidated H1 revenue Rs 4,403.5 cr, PAT up 111.9% to Rs 234.3 cr); separately completed its already-disclosed acquisition of 100% of Purvi Gems & Jewellery (India) for Rs 9 cr.
distress_risk: **Premier Limited** -- intimation of the 21st Committee of Creditors meeting (CIRP).
**DPSC (India Power Corporation)** -- outcome of the voting results of the 8th Committee of Creditors meeting under its CIRP.
**Garware Offshore Services** -- settles its IBC demand notice against Afcons Infrastructure for Rs 2.93 cr (net of tax), against the Rs 3.16 cr originally claimed.
**Jagran Prakashan** -- the Gupta-family NCLT petitions (C.P. 64/2023 and C.P. 57/2025) are heard and adjourned for further arguments to 3-Dec-2026.
**CMI Ltd** -- prior intimation of the 49th Committee of Creditors meeting (CIRP), scheduled 27-Oct-2026.
⚑ **Privi Speciality Chemicals Ltd** -- Summary of the Proceedings of the NCLT Convened Meeting of the Equity Shareholders _(⚑ filing content disagrees with the subject tag -- held out of movers)_.
**3i Infotech Limited** -- pendency of litigation(s)/dispute(s), detail not cached.
**Grovy India** -- the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (Delhi) partly allows its appeal for AY 2020-21, holding no addition under Section 68 is warranted.
**Aditya Ultra Steel** -- receives a GST Appellate Authority (Rajkot) order on an earlier demand; outcome not stated in the cached pages.
**Asian Hotels (North)** -- the Delhi High Court dismissed a public-interest writ petition (Infrastructure Watchdog) against the Company, judgment dated 3-Nov-2025, now reported.
open_offers: **Frontier Capital Ltd** — Prafful Agarwal and Mrs. Anupam Gupta open offer for 26.0% (43.58 lakh shares) at Rs 10.2 vs CMP 12.72 (-19.8%); change of control (Reg 4) + >25% acquisition (Reg 3(1)); no delisting intent; **DO NOT TENDER - market pays more than the offer**; tender window not in PA (comes with DPS/LoF); mcap Rs 21 cr

**Hittco Tools Ltd** — acquirer not parsed open offer for 26.0% (58.77 lakh shares) at Rs 15.3 vs CMP 15.68 (-2.4%); change of control (Reg 4) + >25% acquisition (Reg 3(1)); no delisting intent; **DO NOT TENDER - market pays more than the offer**; tender window not in PA (comes with DPS/LoF); mcap Rs 10 cr
credit_rating_changes: **Vega Jewellers** -- CRISIL DOWNGRADES its long-term rating to Crisil BBB-/Stable from Crisil BBB/Stable, citing constrained liquidity (bank-limit utilisation around 98-99%); facility size not published (corrects the baseline's 'Revised Credit Rating' line, which did not say which way the rating moved).
**LEAP India** -- update on credit ratings of wholly owned subsidiary TARON Material Handling Equipments.
other_notable: **Embassy Developments Limited** -- allotment of 1,22,00,000 equity shares on conversion of warrants (Rs 102.03 cr).

**Advance Multitech** -- allots 97,25,000 convertible warrants at Rs 40/warrant to 118 non-promoter allottees, Rs 38.90 cr total consideration; only 25% (Rs 9.73 cr) received upfront, balance payable only on conversion within 18 months (filed twice; carried once).
**Kuber Udyog Ltd** -- pre-offer public advertisement copy submitted to BSE under SAST Regulation 18(7).
**Choice International** -- Board meeting scheduled 02-Nov-2026 to consider unaudited financial results.
**Samvardhana Motherson International Limited** -- Reg 30 disclosure, detail not cached.
**Advanced Enzyme Technologies Ltd** -- buyback of equity shares from the open market via stock exchanges.
**FDC Limited** -- record date for its buyback fixed at 13-Nov-2026.
**Share India Securities** -- action(s) taken or orders passed (Reg 30 penalty intimation), detail not cached.
**Great Eastern Shipping Company Ltd** -- daily buyback report for 27-Oct-2026.
**Pro Clb Global Ltd** -- launch of its official social-media handles.
